Rodrigo Ventocilla, a Harvard trans activist from Peru, died in Bali police custody in 2022 after arrest at Bali airport on his honeymoon (family alleges police beating; police deny violence).

records.name: Pakistan
records.summary_text: Pakistan is dangerous for trans travellers — legally progressive on paper but severely undermined in practice. The 2018 Transgender Persons Protection Act is described as one of the most progressive pieces of legislation internationally, but the national religious court (the Shariat Court) gutted it in 2023, declaring provisions "un-Islamic". Transgender people face extreme violence: three trans women were shot dead in Karachi, the largest city of the country, 267 violence cases were documented in one state/province (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa), and police commit a documented "continuum of violence
